name.zh: 张家口—多伦（察哈尔抗日同盟军）

description.zh: 1933 年 6 月，冯玉祥、吉鸿昌等率察哈尔民众抗日同盟军自张家口北上，7 月 12 日收复多伦。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In June 1933 Feng Yuxiang, Ji Hongchang, and others led the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army north from Zhangjiakou and recovered Duolun on 12 July. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.
